learn.title: Learn
learn.intro: Plain answers to common questions about cannabis, our products and how pickup works. This page is general information, not medical advice. For questions about your health, talk with a healthcare professional.

sections.title: Hybrid, Indica and Sativa
sections.body:
Hybrid, indica and sativa are the names growers use for a plant's type. Hybrids mix traits from both parents. Sativa-leaning plants are usually taller with narrow leaves and a longer flowering period. Indica-leaning plants tend to be shorter and bushier.

Shoppers often use these names as a rough guide to how a product might feel. The chemistry on the label, especially THC and CBD, and the terpenes that give each strain its aroma, tell you more. Everyone reacts differently, so treat the type as a starting point, not a promise.

sections.title: Reading a label
sections.body:
THC is the cannabinoid most associated with the feeling of being high. CBD is a cannabinoid that does not cause that feeling. Labels show both as a percentage for flower and concentrates, and as milligrams per package or serving for edibles and drinks.

For edibles, check the serving size and the total milligrams in the package, then work out how much you are taking. Terpenes give cannabis its smell and taste. Some lab reports list them.

sections.title: Start low and go slow
sections.body:
Begin with a small amount: one serving of an edible, or a single puff or short inhale. Wait before you take more. Edibles can take 30 to 120 minutes to take effect and can last much longer than smoked or vaped products. Waiting two hours before a second serving is a common rule of thumb.

After using cannabis, do not drive or operate machinery. Keep products in a safe place out of reach of children and pets, and store edibles clearly labelled so no one mistakes them for regular snacks.

sections.title: Lab tested products
sections.body: Many products come with a certificate of analysis from a licensed testing laboratory. These reports list potency and screening results, such as pesticides, microbes, heavy metals and residual solvents. When a lab report is available for a product, it is linked from that product's page.

sections.title: How pickup works
sections.body:
Choose your products online, pick a pickup time, and we will prepare your order. Most orders are ready in 30 to 60 minutes. Your time window is shown at checkout and in your bag.

Have a valid government-issued photo ID ready when you pick up your order.

sections.title: Age and ID requirements
sections.body: You must be 21 or older to buy cannabis. Have a valid government-issued photo ID ready at pickup. Medical purchases also need a valid medical cannabis ID.

sections.title: Using cannabis safely
sections.body: Cannabis can affect coordination, judgement, memory and reaction time. Avoid combining it with alcohol or other sedatives. Check with a healthcare professional before using cannabis if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking other medication.
